# SDA AI Services

> Dubai-based AI agency (SDA SERVICES L.L.C-FZ, Meydan, Dubai, UAE). SDA stands for Software, Development, Applications & AI Services. We build AI agents, workflow automation, custom web and mobile apps, data management and SAP integration for companies in the UAE and GCC. Every project starts with a free pilot; prices are fixed, in AED, with no per-user fees. Languages: English and Arabic.

Contact: yigit@sda-services.ai · WhatsApp +971 54 237 7342 · https://sda-services.ai/contact

## Services
- [AI agents & assistants](https://sda-services.ai/services/ai-agents): Custom AI agents and chatbots for UAE businesses: answers from your documents, actions in your systems, on WhatsApp, web and voice. Free pilot.
- [Workflow automation](https://sda-services.ai/services/workflow-automation): Automate approvals, invoices, documents and reporting with AI. End-to-end process automation for UAE and GCC companies, with a free pilot.
- [Custom web applications](https://sda-services.ai/services/web-applications): Custom web applications, portals and SaaS products with AI built in, for companies in Dubai, the UAE and GCC. Fixed prices and a free pilot.
- [Mobile & field apps](https://sda-services.ai/services/mobile-apps): iOS, Android and offline field service apps for UAE teams: photos, GPS, signatures and checklists synced to your back office. Free pilot.
- [Data management](https://sda-services.ai/services/data-management): Clean, connected data and live KPI dashboards for UAE companies: data integration, master data and governance that your AI can rely on.
- [Enterprise & SAP integration](https://sda-services.ai/services/sap-integration): Connect AI to SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, CRMs and legacy systems in the UAE. Clean-core extensions, secure APIs and middleware without downtime.

## Solutions
- [WhatsApp AI chatbot](https://sda-services.ai/solutions/whatsapp-ai-chatbot): WhatsApp AI chatbots for UAE businesses on the official WhatsApp Business Platform: answers, bookings, order status and human handover, in Arabic and English.
- [Arabic AI assistant](https://sda-services.ai/solutions/arabic-ai-chatbot): Arabic AI chatbots and assistants for GCC companies: Modern Standard Arabic and Gulf dialects, right-to-left interfaces, answers from your own documents.
- [AI document processing](https://sda-services.ai/solutions/ai-document-processing): AI document processing for UAE companies: invoices, delivery notes, contracts and forms in Arabic and English read, checked and entered into your ERP.

- [Energy & utilities](https://sda-services.ai/industries/energy): AI and mobile software for GCC energy and utility companies: field crews, asset data, inspections and maintenance plans connected to SAP and core systems.
